release_notes: Templates and reporting, done properly. 196 traffic-source and 395 affiliate-network templates generated from Keitaro's own exports now ship built-in (209 sources and 438 networks in the dropdowns, nothing to import by hand) - they replace a hand-written batch whose macros were invented and quietly tracked nothing: PopAds swapped the click id for the site id, MaxBounty used the wrong sub and payout macro, Zeydoo had payout and subid reversed, several networks pointed at postback hosts that do not exist. Keitaro status transforms ({status: lead=reg sale=dep}) and the {clickid}/{offer_id}/{conversion_revenue} macros those templates rely on now resolve in outgoing postbacks. Reports gain a customizer: searchable column picker with presets (COD, Lander-to-Offer, Finance & ROI), up to five group-by levels with URL-param dimensions, eq/neq/contains filters, and drag-and-drop column reordering on the header. 30+ metrics (LP CTR, approve rate, revenue split by status, real aggregator revenue and ROI, CPC/CPA/EPC/UEPC) computed in one shared place with a sticky totals row - purchases now count conversions rather than clicks, and ROI at zero spend shows a dash instead of 100%. The new date-range picker pairs an interactive calendar with a working timezone: the selection shifts every date condition on the server, not just the label. Redirect streams can point at a direct external URL with {subid}/{clickid}/{ip}/{country} and captured parameters substituted. Cloaking UI refined to per-layer toggles with a segmented safe-page selector; the landing editor gains every redirect method (JS, meta, iframe, form POST, preload, cURL proxy). Cost Sync adds an in-campaign connection modal and manual spend entry. Bot-list import is transactional and chunked - 50k+ IPs or UAs import without timing out. Migration 19 indexes conversions/revenue_records/clicks joins so dashboards stop scanning tables end to end. The update check no longer reports 'no update' when GitHub is unreachable - it says the check failed and gives the manual git pull. i18n check is green with full parity across all 7 locales; dist rebuilt.
